spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Massive touch targets for gloved hands. High contrast boundaries. Vertical data entry flow.
spacing_and_layout.buttons: Minimum height h-14, ideally h-16 for primary CTAs. Full-width on mobile.
spacing_and_layout.inputs: Height h-14. Large text (text-lg) to prevent squinting in sunlight.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid. Dense but clearly separated by thick 2px borders.
spacing_and_layout.print_layout: Strict Swiss Grid. Monochrome, removing all gradients/shadows. High-density data tables.

components.toggles: Segmented controls (YES/NO/N/A) spanning full width. YES = muted green active state, NO = bright red active state.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces (NO glassmorphism). 1px or 2px solid border (border-slate-300). No soft shadows, use hard drop-shadows if needed.
components.camera_upload: Massive dashed border zone. h-32 minimum. Icon center.
components.signature: Solid border canvas area. Clear 'Clear' button. Must save as base64/image for PDF.

image_urls.description: Construction worker inspects rebar. Use for dashboard hero or 'No recent inspections' empty state.
Blueprint texture. Use at extremely low opacity (5-10%) in the background of the auth screen or main dashboard wrapper.

logo.instructions: Do not use an image placeholder. Create a purely CSS-based logo: The word 'MASCI' in 'Chivo' font, font-black, tracking-tighter. Add a small safety yellow square (w-3 h-3 bg-yellow-500) next to it.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Shift background colors sharply. No slow fades. Hardware-like snapping.
motion_and_interaction.focus: 2px solid blue (ring-2 ring-blue-600 ring-offset-2) to ensure visibility in glare.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement pure light mode (forced) for sunlight readability. Disable dark mode inversion.
Forms must use custom Shadcn inputs with extremely large touch targets (h-14).
Use react-signature-canvas for the signature pad. Ensure drawing captures cleanly for PDF.

For PDF generation, strongly recommend using `react-to-print` or `window.print()` with a custom `@media print` CSS block that hides navigation and formats the form data as a clean, branded MASCI report.
Ensure all inputs, especially YES/NO segmented controls, have clear high-contrast states.
In the PDF view, apply strict Swiss brutalist typography. Black and white, thin borders, highly professional. Ensure no page breaks inside critical sections.
